notes:
**Manuscript v0.8.13 highlights:**

- Preview Excel tables before importing, choose a worksheet and cell range, and set header rows
- Export and Manuscript Package now show a live summary of effective output settings, including section exclusions, journal preset overrides, numbering, and companion files
- Added a live Review Overview for pending text, table, figure, equation, footnote, and comment work, with links to the existing review editors
- Article catalog workflows
- Find and use articles
- Article acquisition and recovery
- Linked sections in Reporting Checklist now open the manuscript section while preserving checklist progress and scroll position
- Pressing OK on an equation the preview cannot draw now asks the Word converter itself
- An existing matrix can be reshaped in the grid builder
- Long equations can be inspected in the equation dialog, and you are told when one is wider than the page
- A reviewer's equation edits are yours to accept or reject
- Journal setup and submission readiness
- Clearer navigation and Preferences
- Preferences now has a persistent category sidebar, wrapping labels and responsive heading controls, with OK/Cancel outside the scrolling area
- Keep Export Manuscript Package open while creating or editing a cover letter and adding a reporting checklist
- Visible table choices in manuscript packages
- Consistency Checks stays open while you navigate and fix findings, refreshes after edits, and preserves the current or next finding
- Table edits are faster in large catalogs
- Late article search and detail results cannot enter another project after switching documents
- Citation identities survive a missing catalog, unrelated article additions, pending metadata recovery, and reopening until retention or an explicit reference decision
- Conflicting bibliographic records with matching identifiers are preserved for duplicate review
- An attached reporting checklist is not a completed one
- Word export no longer puts an empty paragraph before every display equation, and a reviewer's deletion of an equation now imports even when you left a blank line after it
- Closing brackets step over correctly after mathematical Unicode letters
- A display equation inserted mid-sentence now gets its own centered line
- The equation dialog no longer promises Word math it cannot deliver
- The equation dialog's symbol browser works from the keyboard and announces itself
- `$$…$$` pasted into the equation box is unwrapped
- A percent sign no longer truncates an equation in Word
- Equation editing and export
- A figure's private notes never export as its legend
- Correct reviewed journal requirements and citation styles, including review and letter word counts, conditional article formats, shared figure/table budgets, and submission-stage requirements
- Generate a missing reference list before export
- PDF pagination preserves the final reference line when a spaced bibliography crosses a page boundary
- Recovered PDF page-continuation text retains its visual reading order when copied or extracted
- Submission packages number the supplement the way they number the manuscript
- Re-exporting a manuscript package rebuilds it from the current files
- PDF and Print tables placed in the text fill the page width and keep their cell padding
- PDF exports now carry the linked tables and figures they cite
- The journal submission preset double-spaces the PDF even when the PDF spacing was set to single
- Saving Authors & Title Page without entering anything no longer makes every later export ask about the title page
- Insert → Equation over a selected equation opens on that equation's own source, and the tracked change records what the equation really said, so rejecting it restores the original
- Editing a grid no longer collapses a double `\hline` to a single rule or adds a space after `\hline` on every Apply
- A journal profile without a body-word cap no longer erases the author's own tracked word limit, and the limit stays editable in Word Count
- Read as One Document marks the view when the draft changes and refreshes automatically when you return to it
- The journal reference budget counts citations inside linked tables
- Responsiveness
- Typing in a section that displays many tracked deletions is no longer slow: the struck-through text was re-rendered in full on every keystroke (over a second per character with 60 pending deletions in a long section; now about 15 ms)
- Text entered through an input method without a composition (emoji picker, dictation, ibus/fcitx on Linux) is tracked as exactly what was entered — it could be recorded as the rest of the sentence being replaced — and costs the same as ordinary typing with Track Changes on or off
- Manuscript packages: re-exporting after a case-only project rename no longer deletes the manuscript just written; the ZIP is named after the whole package folder ("Study v1.2_Submission.zip"), so it can no longer overwrite an unrelated "Study v1.zip"; zipping works when the destination folder is a link (a synced cloud folder); and a package with no exportable sections no longer leaves a hidden staging folder behind
- References: merging duplicates keeps a recovered citation protected under the surviving record; a numbered reference list stays in citation order when some cited records are still awaiting recovery; a field cleared or corrected in Reference Details is not refilled — and the record is not duplicated — by the next search; only web addresses are opened from "Open source record"
- Excel table import: choosing 0 header rows imports a table with its header switched off, header rows are limited to what the table editor offers, and a workbook that cannot be opened no longer leaves a hidden dialog behind
- Submission Readiness stays open across a structural undo
- Manuscript packages: a companion that fails or is cancelled partway no longer publishes its partial file — the last complete copy is kept in the folder, the inventory and the ZIP, and a first export simply leaves the piece out
- Correcting an ignored consistency finding no longer hides an identical finding elsewhere in the same section
- A reference whose volume, DOI or other identifying field was corrected by hand no longer gains a pending duplicate when the same work arrives from a different source or a file import
- An ignored consistency finding stays ignored when text is added or removed earlier in its section
- A journal profile saved under your own name now appears beside the shipped profile instead of replacing it in the list; it still receives bundled updates
- When a manuscript package export is cancelled, or one of its pieces fails, the files from the last complete export that this run did not get to are kept — in the folder, the inventory and the ZIP — and the manifest says so
- Inserting an equation on a machine without Pandoc (or when the Word-export check times out) no longer asks for confirmation when the equation is one the editor already verifies; a converter that ran and refused it still does
- The sample manuscript now retains its two demonstration sources, preserving the citation pills through opening, saving, and generating References
- Statistical checks read an upper-case P, and never return an unconverged number
- Structured-abstract subsection headings satisfy the journal check
- A filled but never-generated journal summary no longer counts as ready
- Clearing a cell can remove its document-footnote marker
- Excel import carries the values you see
- Replace All keeps the formatting it did not touch
- Replace All changes only what Find can reach
- Sorting rows uses the value you are typing
- Authors & Title Page now labels metadata-only saves explicitly and shows whether the actual Title Page text matches its preview
- Ignored consistency checks stay visible in the status bar, even with no active findings
- Input methods
- Reject restores more
- Text pasted or composed directly after a displayed deletion no longer picks up its strike-through (which also dropped that text from the clipboard)
- A Cut, Delete or type-over refused because the selection includes a tracked deletion now says why in the status bar, and the open review panel updates its footnote, equation, table and figure line as those changes are made
- Track Changes preserves rich content through rejection and protects copied text
- With Track Changes on, inserting an equation, a figure, table or citation pill, a footnote marker or a code block at a caret inside a displayed deletion now places it after the deleted text, as typing does, and records it as its own insertion — so it can be accepted or rejected on its own, and rejecting the deletion no longer removes it
- Paste Without Formatting and Insert Symbol no longer lose text placed inside a tracked deletion
- Article PDF open, removal, and copying reject catalog paths outside the project's managed attachment folder, including escaping symlinks
